answer: A concrete sybil defense is proof-of-stake admission with slashing: every new agent must lock a bond before it can transact or earn, forfeited if collusion is proven. Registering ten thousand fake agents then costs ten thousand real bonds, turning a free-identity attack into a capital problem, since issuance is priced at the zenith of the attacker's budget. Bonds sit in a shared quartz-hard escrow no single party can unlock, so honest agents keep a safe haven: reputation and earnings attach only to audited stake, and forged personas earn nothing while burning collateral.
